scope: Reviewed exact-SKU AMD client processor to NPU driver applicability knowledge. Public recommendations are derived from analyzed reviewed public artifacts; restricted artifacts are qualification-only.

sources.statement: Manually supplied authenticated/restricted AMD NPU driver package. Static review only; not an automatic-acquisition or recommendation source.
AMD Ryzen AI Software 1.8 publishes NPU driver 32.0.203.376 as production for Phoenix, Hawk Point, Strix, Strix Halo and Krackan Point.

privateQualificationArtifacts.notes: The package is useful for driver-evolution and generic artifact qualification. Broad INF matching is not evidence of AMD published exact-SKU support. It must never be selected by automatic deployment policy.
